changelog: Your phone finds your computer on Wi-Fi again. When your router handed the computer a new address, the phone had no way to learn it — so it quietly fell back to the remote (Tailscale) connection and stayed there, even when both were sitting on the same Wi-Fi. Your computer now tells the phone where it is, so the phone corrects itself automatically and comes back to Wi-Fi on its own. The connection status is also honest now: it reports the connection you're actually on instead of guessing from the address it dialled. Also fixed: with a Privacy Lock PIN set, one way of asking could still read locked notes.
